description: Real-time X (Twitter) SYNTHESIS for a Robinhood Chain token: what the crowd is saying (narrative), sentiment, conviction (organic vs bot/shill), red flags, and — the differentiator — activity from PROVEN early-callers measured to precede price moves (not follower counts). Fuses live X with RobinX caller-lift and on-chain data; skeptical by design. Use when you need the social read on a token, not just the on-chain one. Costs $0.04 USDC on Base.
